legal_ref: Закон за данък върху добавената стойност (ЗДДС), чл. 66, ал. 1, т. 1
quote: Стандартна ставка на данъка - 20% — Standard tax rate 20% (applies to taxable supplies in the country, imports and intra-Community acquisitions)
source_title: Национална агенция за приходите (NRA) — ДДС в България

reduced_rates.scope: hotel accommodation; books and periodicals (physical or electronic); baby food and food for young children (ZDDS art. 66(2)); TEDB also lists certain pharmaceuticals
zero-rated supplies under Chapter 3 and arts. 53, 64a, 140, 146, 173 ZDDS (exports, intra-EU supplies, international transport)

notes: Registration threshold for established persons: EUR 51,130 annual turnover (NRA, figures in euro after Bulgaria's euro changeover). No sub-national VAT. TEDB cross-check: 20% standard, 9% reduced — consistent.
unverified: valid_from: 20% has applied since 1999-01-01 under the former VAT law; 2007-01-01 is the commencement of the current ZDDS (DV 63/2006). Neither date confirmed in an official text fetched
